summary: Two companies pass the shattered gates within a day of one another. A lurking horror in the shadow of the gates claims the campaign's first grave.

report.outcome: The campaign ledger records an Oathbound victory: they entered in good order and recovered their first wyrdstone. The Wolves reached and looted the eastern gatehouse first, but lost Olga. The original rulebook scenario and the exact winning condition were not recorded.
report.prologue: The shattered gates stand open, but the approaches are not safe. Two companies are entering Mordheim within a day of one another, seeking a foothold among the gatehouses and the first fragments of wyrdstone. Rain obscures the rooftops; something moves in the shadows below.
battle: The Oathbound made an orderly passage through the gates. Thorgrim pried a wyrdstone shard from a gargoyle's mouth, while Grimnir marked safe rooftop routes on the company map. Snorri stepped over a pressure plate without noticing it, sparing the vanguard behind him.

Borri fired the campaign's first shot, dropping a lurking shape from a bell tower at extreme range. Dagna went alone into the gatehouse shadows and returned dragging a dead ghoul. Okri remained steady at his weapon, unaware of the screaming in the dark or the recall horn that followed.

At the eastern gatehouse, the Wolves secured an early advantage. Boris negotiated passage without a toll and Yuri shouldered a fallen portcullis aside for the wagon. Olga scouted ahead and marked a safe route, but a lurking horror caught her in the shadows. Anya's arrow struck its eye too late to save her.

The day's gains were carried into camp, along with the cost of entering the city. The dwarfs had lost no warriors, though rain had ruined Borri's lantern plans. The Wolves had looted the gatehouse before dusk, but their first expedition ended with a grave.
report.epilogue: Both companies establish a foothold inside the city. The Oathbound receive the ledger's victory; Olga's death becomes the campaign's first lasting loss.

perspectives.prologue: We have come from Karak Kadrin under an oath, not on a treasure-seeker's whim. Beyond these gates lies the wealth owed to our vaults. Keep the company together, mark the roofs, and let the first shard prove that this march was not in vain.
perspectives.epilogue: Every dwarf has come through alive, and Thorgrim has the first shard in his own hand. Yet the Wolves reached the eastern gatehouse before our scouts. There is already an entry in the grudge ledger, and Borri's soaked plans must wait for a drier day.
perspectives.accomplishments: Established a foothold without losing a warrior, recovered the first wyrdstone, and mapped safe routes through the gate district.

perspectives.prologue: Beyond the gates is the money that might buy our lands back. We must reach the gatehouse before the dwarfs and bring the wagon through in one piece. Ludmilla says the shadows are hungry; there is little comfort in the crows gathering above us.
perspectives.epilogue: The eastern gatehouse was ours before dusk, but Olga will never share its spoils. Yuri arrived too late and Anya's shot could not undo it. Boris has given the clan a new law: no Wolf scouts alone again.
perspectives.accomplishments: Reached and looted the eastern gatehouse first, brought the wagon through, and avoided the road-wardens' toll.

loot: First wyrdstone recovered by the Oathbound; their post-scenario holdings are 3 shards.
The Wolves looted the eastern gatehouse; their post-scenario holdings are 1 shard. An itemised haul was not recorded.
campaignNotes: Olga the Axe-Widow was killed by a lurking horror and buried with her axe. No opposing warband member is credited with her death.
Boris decreed that no Wolf scouts alone again.
Thorgrim's first grudge records the Wolves beating his scouts to the eastern gatehouse.
Borri's wyrdstone-lantern schematics were ruined by rain.

warbands.name: Grimhammer's Oathbound
highlights: Entered the city in good order and claimed the first wyrdstone shards of the campaign.
lowlights: Borri's lantern schematics were soaked crossing the river moat.

members.name: Thorgrim Grimhammer
members.highlight: Led the Oathbound through the gates without losing a single warrior, and pried the first wyrdstone shard from a gargoyle's mouth himself.
members.lowlight: Entered the first grudge of the campaign in his ledger when the Wolves beat his scouts to the eastern gatehouse.

members.name: Borri Forkbeard
members.highlight: Dropped a lurking shape from a bell tower with 'Grudge-Settler' at extreme range — the first shot fired in the campaign.
members.lowlight: His wyrdstone-lantern schematics were ruined by rain before he could test them.

members.name: Dagna Ironmaid
members.highlight: Charged alone into the gatehouse shadows looking for her doom and came out disappointed, dragging a dead ghoul by the ankle.
members.lowlight: Found nothing in Mordheim's gate district mighty enough to grant her a worthy doom.

members.name: Snorri Halfpint
members.highlight: Stepped over a pressure-plate trap without noticing it, saving the entire vanguard behind him.
members.lowlight: Was made to walk in front from that day on.

members.name: Grimnir Coalfist
members.highlight: Said nothing all day, but marked every safe rooftop route on the company map in perfect silence.
members.lowlight: Lost his boot-knife to the mud of the gate causeway.

members.name: Okri Stonebrow
members.highlight: Stood his ground and reloaded calmly while something screamed at him from the dark — he never heard it.
members.lowlight: Missed the recall horn twice and had to be fetched by Snorri.

members.name: Durgin Alebelly
members.highlight: Located a rumour of an intact brewery cellar before the company had even made camp.
members.lowlight: Drank the expedition's welcome-toast ration single-handedly.

warbands.name: Wolfenstein's Wolves
highlights: Beat the dwarfs to the eastern gatehouse and looted it before dusk.
lowlights: Olga the Axe-Widow fell to a lurking horror on the very first day — the campaign's first grave.

members.name: Boris Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Talked the clan past a band of road-wardens at the gates without paying a single toll.
members.lowlight: Had to dig the clan's first grave and decreed that no Wolf scouts alone again.

members.name: Yuri Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Shouldered a fallen portcullis open so the clan wagon could pass the gates.
members.lowlight: Arrived too late to save Olga, a failure he drinks to forget.

members.name: Anya Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Put an arrow through the lurking horror's eye at forty paces — the first notch of the campaign on her bow.
members.lowlight: The shot came a heartbeat too late for Olga.

members.name: Ludmilla the Crow-Mother
members.highlight: The crows gathered to her the moment the clan passed the gates, and she spoke the old blessings over the camp.
members.lowlight: Warned that the shadows by the gates were hungry; the warning was heeded one warrior too late.

members.name: Pavel the Slow
members.highlight: Carried the clan banner, the cooking pot, and a door he took a liking to, all through the gates in one trip.
members.lowlight: Was still crossing the causeway when the fighting at the gatehouse ended.

members.name: Mikhail Halfhand
members.highlight: Won the clan's gate-toll money back from a caravan guard with his loaded dice before they even entered the city.
members.lowlight: Was caught palming a die and had to leave the caravan camp at a run.

members.name: Dmitri Wolfenstein
members.highlight: First of the Wolves through the shattered gates, sword drawn, singing an Ostland marching song.
members.lowlight: Tripped on the threshold of the City of the Damned, which everyone agreed was a bad omen.

members.name: Olga the Axe-Widow
members.highlight: Scouted ahead alone, fearless as ever, and marked the safest path to the gatehouse before anyone else dared move.
members.lowlight: Fell to a lurking horror in the shadow of the gates — the first grave the campaign dug. Buried with her axe.
